items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I was the first to record Jesse Belvin, for instance.

ctx.x: Oh, yes, I remember. You said it was at Frank Sebastian's Cotton Club.

Then in later years I made many records with Bumps, because I was an A&R man for Dolphin's of Hollywood during one period, and we used to record every single day. I was the first to record Jesse Belvin, for instance. I used to do all the arranging and all the contracting and all the producing for that little company. Later, when I remember the name of the company, I'll insert it somewhere, but it was Jack Lauderdale's company who Lloyd Glenn was a star with. So Jack hired me to be an A&R man... Did I tell this…
